svg.title: Cumulative verification cost and the cached-envelope alternative
svg.desc: Cumulative processing and per-check costs from the full paper, including the envelope-only alternative. The graph path costs more initially and crosses over against fresh expansion at 4.24 additional checks for the 146-quad fixture. The dashed envelope-only curve assumes a trusted cached mapping and excludes its validation. These are prototype processing costs, not complete service latencies. Source: paper [full paper], Figure 4.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Cumulative verification cost and the cached-envelope alternative

Cumulative processing and per-check costs from the full paper, including the envelope-only alternative. The graph path costs more initially and crosses over against fresh expansion at 4.24 additional checks for the 146-quad fixture. The dashed envelope-only curve assumes a trusted cached mapping and excludes its validation. These are prototype processing costs, not complete service latencies. Source: paper [full paper], Figure 4.
